events.title: OpenAI starts a US rollout of ChatGPT Wallet with per-purchase approval
events.title_zh: OpenAI 在美国小范围开放 ChatGPT Wallet，每笔购买需确认
events.summary: OpenAI began a rolling ChatGPT Wallet launch for eligible US users aged 18 or older, initially on ChatGPT Pro and supported US-issued cards. Users review the items, total and card, then complete a security check for each purchase. Card details are tokenized, and delegated or autonomous spending is not part of the current release.
events.summary_en: OpenAI began a rolling ChatGPT Wallet launch for eligible US users aged 18 or older, initially on ChatGPT Pro and supported US-issued cards. Users review the items, total and card, then complete a security check for each purchase. Card details are tokenized, and delegated or autonomous spending is not part of the current release.
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 开始分批开放 ChatGPT Wallet，首批面向年满 18 岁、使用受支持美国发卡行卡片的美国 ChatGPT Pro 用户。用户每次都要核对商品、总价和卡片，再完成安全检查。卡号会被 token 化；当前版本不支持委托或自主消费。
events.why_it_matters: For commerce-agent builders, this introduces a real transaction boundary with explicit user confirmation and tokenized payment credentials. The rollout is narrow and does not yet prove that autonomous purchasing can be made safe or reliable.
events.why_it_matters_en: For commerce-agent builders, this introduces a real transaction boundary with explicit user confirmation and tokenized payment credentials. The rollout is narrow and does not yet prove that autonomous purchasing can be made safe or reliable.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 commerce agent 开发者来说，这首次给出带显式确认和 token 化支付凭据的真实交易边界。开放范围很窄，也不能证明自主购买已经安全可靠。

technical_details.eligibility: US, age 18+, initially ChatGPT Pro, eligible US-issued cards
technical_details.authorization: user reviews and approves every purchase with a security check
technical_details.credential_handling: payment token; merchant does not receive the actual card number
technical_details.limitation: no delegated spending in the current release

technical_details_zh.资格: 美国、年满 18 岁；首批 ChatGPT Pro；受支持的美国发卡行卡片
technical_details_zh.授权: 每笔购买都由用户核对并完成安全检查
technical_details_zh.凭据处理: 使用 payment token；商家不接收真实卡号

events.next_action_zh: 等待开放开发者测试环境、退款争议流程与非美国可用范围后，再设计支付接入。
events.next_action_en: Wait for a developer test environment, dispute and refund flows, and non-US availability before designing a payment integration.

evidence.claim_zh: ChatGPT Wallet 开始面向部分美国 Pro 用户分批开放。
evidence.claim_en: ChatGPT Wallet begins rolling out to a subset of US Pro users.

changes.summary_zh: ChatGPT Wallet 开始面向部分美国 Pro 用户分批开放。
changes.summary_en: ChatGPT Wallet begins rolling out to a subset of US Pro users.

events.title: XYBench tests whether models recover the user’s real goal from a mistaken request
events.title_zh: XYBench 测试模型能否从错误请求中找回用户真实目标
events.summary: XYBench publishes 8,115 questions that distinguish a user’s stated approach from the underlying goal, drawing from Stack Overflow, Stack Exchange, manual writing and WikiHow-derived generation. The authors find that evaluated models often optimize the literal request instead of correcting the mistaken approach. The dataset and code are public under Apache-2.0.
events.summary_en: XYBench publishes 8,115 questions that distinguish a user’s stated approach from the underlying goal, drawing from Stack Overflow, Stack Exchange, manual writing and WikiHow-derived generation. The authors find that evaluated models often optimize the literal request instead of correcting the mistaken approach. The dataset and code are public under Apache-2.0.
events.summary_zh: XYBench 发布 8,115 道题，专门区分用户说出的做法与背后的真实目标。题目来自 Stack Overflow、Stack Exchange、人工编写和基于 WikiHow 的生成数据。作者发现，被测模型常常只优化字面请求，而没有纠正错误做法。数据集和代码以 Apache-2.0 公开。
events.why_it_matters: For coding assistants and support agents, literal task completion can still fail the user’s actual objective. The benchmark is reproducible, but its English, procedural and single-turn emphasis limits claims about production conversations.
events.why_it_matters_en: For coding assistants and support agents, literal task completion can still fail the user’s actual objective. The benchmark is reproducible, but its English, procedural and single-turn emphasis limits claims about production conversations.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对编程助手和客服 agent 来说，照字面完成任务仍可能让用户离真实目标更远。这个 benchmark 可复跑，但它偏英语、流程题和单轮交互，不能直接代表生产对话。

technical_details.sources: 1,557 Stack Overflow; 184 Stack Exchange; 102 manual; 6,272 WikiHow-derived
technical_details.grading: Sonnet 4.5 judge; two reviewers checked 500 responses
technical_details.time_basis: official feed timestamp 2026-11-13T17:02:35Z; two minutes before cutoff

technical_details_zh.来源: Stack Overflow 1,557；Stack Exchange 184；人工 102；WikiHow 派生 6,272
technical_details_zh.评分: Sonnet 4.5 judge；两名人工复核者检查 500 个回答
technical_details_zh.局限: 偏英语、流程题与单轮交互
technical_details_zh.时间依据: 官方 feed 时间 2026-11-13T17:02:35Z；距边界约两分钟

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用公开数据抽取 100 题评测当前编程助手，分别记录照字面执行、追问与纠错比例。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, sample 100 public cases against the current coding assistant and record literal execution, clarification and correction rates.

evidence.claim_zh: AllenAI 公开 XYBench 数据集与评测代码。
evidence.claim_en: AllenAI publishes the XYBench dataset and evaluation code.

changes.summary_zh: AllenAI 公开 XYBench 数据集与评测代码。
changes.summary_en: AllenAI publishes the XYBench dataset and evaluation code.

events.title: smolmaxxing collects experiments for running LLMs on small devices
events.title_zh: smolmaxxing 汇总小设备运行 LLM 的实验
events.summary: The smolmaxxing repository collects scripts and experiments for running different LLMs on small or old devices. It is MIT-licensed and drew rapid community attention, but it does not provide a stable release, controlled cross-device benchmarks or a supported compatibility matrix.
events.summary_en: The smolmaxxing repository collects scripts and experiments for running different LLMs on small or old devices. It is MIT-licensed and drew rapid community attention, but it does not provide a stable release, controlled cross-device benchmarks or a supported compatibility matrix.
events.summary_zh: smolmaxxing 仓库汇总在小型或老旧设备运行不同 LLM 的脚本与实验，采用 MIT 许可证并迅速获得社区关注。它没有稳定 release、受控的跨设备 benchmark 或受支持兼容矩阵。
events.why_it_matters: For local-inference teams, the repository may offer discovery ideas, but its current evidence does not justify replacing maintained runtimes or committing integration work.
events.why_it_matters_en: For local-inference teams, the repository may offer discovery ideas, but its current evidence does not justify replacing maintained runtimes or committing integration work.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对本地推理团队来说，这个仓库可以提供线索，但现有证据不足以替代受维护的运行时，也不值得投入集成。

technical_details.evidence_limit: no stable release, controlled benchmark or support matrix

technical_details_zh.证据限制: 没有稳定 release、受控 benchmark 或支持矩阵

events.next_action_zh: 当前不投入工程时间；等待可复现基准、稳定发布或明确的合规与运维边界后再复核。
events.next_action_en: Do not invest engineering time now; revisit after reproducible benchmarks, a stable release, or clear compliance and operational boundaries.

evidence.claim_zh: 公开页面能证明项目存在，但不足以支持生产采用。
evidence.claim_en: The public page establishes that the project exists but does not support production adoption.

changes.summary_zh: 召回自检确认项目热度，但证据不足，明确标为 IGNORE。
changes.summary_en: Recall audit confirms community interest but insufficient evidence, explicitly dispositioned as IGNORE.

events.title: LibreAGI launches a private tracker for preserving open model weights
events.title_zh: LibreAGI 推出保存开放模型权重的私有 tracker
events.summary: LibreAGI describes a members-only BitTorrent tracker that mirrors model weights and publishes signed hashes and source references. The public page lists accepted licenses, but access is private and this run did not verify redistribution permissions for individual artifacts, operator identity, abuse handling or long-term availability.
events.summary_en: LibreAGI describes a members-only BitTorrent tracker that mirrors model weights and publishes signed hashes and source references. The public page lists accepted licenses, but access is private and this run did not verify redistribution permissions for individual artifacts, operator identity, abuse handling or long-term availability.
events.summary_zh: LibreAGI 自称是会员制 BitTorrent tracker，用于镜像模型权重，并公布签名 hash 与来源引用。公开页面列出可接受许可证，但访问是私有的；本轮没有逐项核实再分发权限、运营者身份、滥用处理或长期可用性。
events.why_it_matters: For teams preserving model artifacts, provenance and redistribution rights matter more than a private catalog claim. The present legal, security and operational boundaries are too unclear for adoption.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams preserving model artifacts, provenance and redistribution rights matter more than a private catalog claim. The present legal, security and operational boundaries are too unclear for adoption.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对保存模型产物的团队来说，来源与再分发权利比私有目录的自述更重要。当前法律、安全和运维边界都不够清楚，不应采用。

technical_details.claimed_integrity: signed public catalog with hashes and source commits
technical_details.evidence_limit: operator, per-artifact redistribution rights, abuse handling and availability not independently verified
technical_details.time_basis: public page did not provide a precise official publication time; HN post is within the run window

technical_details_zh.自述完整性: 带 hash 与来源 commit 的签名公开目录
technical_details_zh.证据限制: 运营者、逐项再分发权、滥用处理与可用性未独立核实
technical_details_zh.时间依据: 公开页面没有精确发布时间；HN 帖子在本轮窗口内

events.next_action_zh: 当前不投入工程时间；等待可复现基准、稳定发布或明确的合规与运维边界后再复核。
events.next_action_en: Do not invest engineering time now; revisit after reproducible benchmarks, a stable release, or clear compliance and operational boundaries.
